items.text: Nehemiya naakoma Abalemi ab'okulema Yerusaalemu
Ekisiika obu kyahoire, mmazire n'okutamu enyigi, abalinzi, abazini, n'Abaleevi bamazire kukomwa,
naha owanyina nyowe Hanani na Hananiya omulemi omukuru ow'ekigo omulimo ogw'okurolerra Yerusaalemu; habwokuba ali muntu omwesigwa kandi arukutiina Ruhanga okukira abandi baingi.

Nkabagambira nti: “Mutalikingura amalembo ga Yerusaalemu; gaikalege gakingire okuhika izooba limazire kuturuka mwihangwe, kandi kutagakingura n'okugatamu ebihongozo abalinzi batakaimukire. Mukome abalinzi omu bantu abasi ba Yerusaalemu, buli omu mumutwale omu kiikaro ky'owabu, kandi alinde haihi n'enju ye.”
Orubuga rukaba ruli rukooto kandi rugalihire, baitu haaraaramuga abantu bake, kandi hakaba hatombekerwemu maju.

Nubwo Ruhanga yantairemu ekiteekerezo eky'okusorooza abantu ab'ekitiinisa, abalemi, n'abantu ab'okuhandiikwa nkooku barukuhonderana omu buzaale bwabo. Nkazoora ekitabu eky'obuzaale obw'abo abaizire okubanza, nkasanga kihandikirwemu kiti:

Ago nugo mabara g'abantu ab'ensi abaarugire omu bunyagwa, hali abo abaazahisiibwe Nebbukadeneeza, omukama wa Bbabbulooni aba akaba azaahisize; bakagaruka Yerusaalemu na Yuda, buli muntu omu rubuga rw'owabo.
Bakaija hamu na Zerubbabbeeri, Yeswa, Nehemiya, Azaliya, Raamiya, Nahamaani, Morodekayi, Birisaani, Misipereresi, Biguvayi, Nehumu na Bbaana.
Gunu nugwo omuhendo ogw'abasaija ab'abantu ba Isirairi.
Batabani ba Parosi, enkumi ibiri kikumi nsanju na babiri.
Batabani ba Sefatiya, ebikumi bbisatu nsanju na babiri.
Batabani b'Aara, rukaaga mu ataano nababiri.
Batabani ba Pahasi-Mowabbu; nubo batabani ba Yeswa na Yowabbu, enkumi ibiri, runaana, ikumi na munaana.
Batabani b'Eramu, orukumi rumu, bibiri, ataano na bana.
Batabani ba Zaatu, runaana mu ana na bataaano.
Batabani ba Zakayi, rusanju omu nkaaga.
Batabani ba Binuwi, rukaaga ana na munaana.
Batabani ba Bebayi, rukaaga abiri na munaana.
Batabani b'Azigaadi, enkumi ibiri, bisatu, abiri na babiri.
Batabani b'Adonikaamu, nkaaga, na musanju.
Batabani ba Biguvayi enkumi ibiri nkaaga na musanju.
Batabani b'Adini, rukaaga ataano na bataano.
Batabani b'Ateeri, nuwe Hezekiya, kyenda na munaana.
Batabani ba Hasumu, ebikumi bisatu, abiri na munaana.
Batabani ba Bezayi, ebikumi bisatu abiri na bbana.
Batabani ba Halifu, kikumi ikumi na babiri.
Batabani ba Gibbyoni, abiri na bataano.
Abasaija ba Beterehemu na Netofa, kikumi kinaana na munaana.
Abasaija ab'Anatoosi, kikumi omu abiri na munaana.
Abasaija ba Besi-azimaveesi, ana na babiri.
Abasaija aba Kiryasi-Yalimu, Kefira na Beeroosi, rusanju ana na basatu.
Abasaija aba Raama Gebba rukaaga abiri n'omu.
Abasaija aba Mikimaasi, kikumi abiri na babiri.
Abasaija aba Beseeri n'Ai, kikumi abiri na basatu.
Abasaija aba Nebbo endi, ataano na babiri.
Batabani b'Eramu ondi, rukumi omu bibiri omu ataano na bana.
Batabani ba Halimu, bikumi bbisatu na abiri.
Batabani ba Yeriko, bisatu ana na bataano.
Batabani ba Loodi, Hadidi na Ono, rusanju abiri n'omu.
Batabani ba Senaha, enkumi isatu, rwenda, na asatu.
Gunu nugwo omuhendo ogw'amabara g'abanyakatagara: Batabani ba Yedaaya, nubo ab'enju ya Yeswa, rwenda nsanju na basatu.
Batabani ba Imeri rukumi ataano na babiri.
Batabani ba Pasihuuli, rukumi, bibiri ana namusanju,
Batabani ba Halimu, rukumi omu ikumi na musanju.
Gunu nugwo omuhendo ogw'Abaleevi: Batabani ba Yeswa, nuwe Kadimyeli owa batabani ba Hodeva, amakumi ana na bbana.
Gunu nugwo omuhendo gw'abazini: Batabani b'Asafu, kikumi ana na munaana.
Gunu nugwo omuhendo gw'abalinzi: Batabani ba Salumu, batabani b'Ateeri, batabani ba Talimooni, batabani b'Akubbu, batabani ba Hatita, batabani ba Sobbai, kikumi asatu na munaana.
Gunu nugwo omuhendo ogw'abaheereza ab'omunju ya MUKAMA: Batabani ba Ziha, batabani ba Hasufa, batabani ba Tabawosi,
batabani ba Kerosi, batabani ba Siaha, batabani ba Padoni,
batabani ba Lebana, batabani ba Hagaba batabani ba Salimai,
batabani ba Hanani, batabani ba Gideri, batabani ba Gahaara,
batabani ba Rehaya, batabani ba Lezini, batabani ba Nekoda,
batabani ba Gazamu, batabani ba Uza,
batabani ba Besayi, batabani ba Mehunimu, batabani ba Nefusesimu, batabani ba Bbakibbbuki
batabani ba Hakufa, batabani ba Halihuli,
batabani ba Baziriisi, batabani ba Mehida, batabani ba Harasa,
batabani ba Barikoosi, aba Sisera, aba Teema,
aba Neziya na Hatifa.
Gunu nugwo omuhendo ogw'abatabani b'abaheereza ba Solomooni: Batabani ba Sotayi, batabani ba Soferesi, batabani ba Perida,
batabani ba Yaala, batabani ba Darakoni, batabani ba Gideri,
batabani ba Sefatiya, batabani ba Hatiri, batabani ba Pokeresihoazebaimu na batabani b'Amoni.
Abaheereza ab'enju ya MUKAMA boona, na batabani b'abairu ba Solomooni, bakahika bbikumi bbisatu kyenda na babiri.
Abo abarukukurataho, nubo abarugire Tirimeera, Teriharasa, Kerubbu, Addoni na Imeri, baitu batasobole kugumya amaju ga baisenkurubo rundi obuzaale bwabo obu baliba baabairekwo Baisirairi.
Batabani ba Delaaya, batabani ba Tobbiya, na batabani ba Nekoda, rukaaga ana na babiri.

Kandi banu nubo ba banyakatagara: Batabani ba Hobbaaya, batabani ba Hakozi, na batabani ba Barazilayi, ba Barazilayi (ow'akaba aswire omukazi omu bahara ba Barazilayi Omugyadi, baamuruka ibara lyabo).
Abo bakaserra nambere baahandiikirwe omuli abo abaahandiikirwe nkooku bakuratana omu buzaale bwabo, baitu batasangwemu, habweki bakasoroorwa omu baanyakatagara, abantu baagira ngu: nibazirwa;
Kurug 28:30
Bir 33:8
omulemi omukuru nukwo kubagambira ngu: tibarukwikirizibwa kulya ha byokulya ebirukwera mali okuhika obu halikazooka nyakatagara anyakwina Ulimu na Tumimu.
Ekitebe kyona hamu, kikaba nikihikya abantu emitwaro ena, omu nkumi ibiri, bisatu n'enkaaga,
otataireho abairu baabo n'abazaana baabo, abakaba nibahika kasanju bisatu asatu na musanju; kandi bakaba baina bbibiri ana na bataano, abasaija n'abakazi.
Embaraasi zaabo zaahikaga rusanju asatu na mukaaga, enyumbu bbibiri omu ana na itaano,
engamiya ebikumi bbina asatu na itaano, enkaina kakaaga rusanju mu abiri.

Abamu omu bakuru b'amaju aga baisenkurubo, bakahayo ebintu eby'okukonyera kwombeka Enju ya MUKAMA. Omulemi omukuru, akaha ekikeeto kiloguraamu munaana za zaabbu, ebbakuli ez'omukoro makumi ataano, ebijwaro bya banyakatagara ebbikumi bbitaano mu asatu.

N'abamu ha bakuru b'amaju baisenkurubo, nabo bakahayo omu lyahurro ly'omulimo, kiloguraamu kikumi nkaaga na munaana za zaabbu emitwaro ebiri, na kiloguraamu rukumi bibiri n'abiri, ez'efeeza enkumi ibiri, ebijwaro bya baanyakatagara nkaaga na musanju.
Abantu abandi ebi baahaire, nizo kiloguraamu kikumi nkaaga na munaana za zaabbu emitwaro ebiri, kiloguraamu kikumi na ana z'efeeza, n'ebijwaro bya banyakatagara nkaaga na musanju.
1 Byok 9:2
Neh 11:3
Aho, Baanyakatagara, Abaleevi, abalinzi, abazini, abamu ha bantu, abaheereza b'enju ya MUKAMA, baikarra omu mbuga z'owaabo.
Okwezi kwa musanju ha kwahikiire, Abaisirairi boona bakaba bamazire ira kwikara omu mbuga zaabo.
